nonpartisanOffice: Mecklenburg County Soil and Water Conservation District Supervisor
basis: All 90 actual current county sample styles reviewed by native text. No local partisan field prints a write-in slot. Soil and Water blank slots are automatically provided without a petition and name no person. This is not a separately acquired named certification list.

rulesProvenance.sourceOrg: North Carolina State Board of Elections
rulesProvenance.quote:
If no person is qualified as a write-in candidate for such a contest, the ballot will not
include a write-in option for that office.

The option for a write-in is automatically included on municipal, Soil &
Water, and nonpartisan Board of Education contests.

remainingGap: No separate named write-in certification inventory acquired. Do not convert unnamed Soil and Water slots into candidacy records.
